alerts.nearCapacity: is near warehouse capacity. Consider building a Warehouse Complex.
alerts.outOfMaintenanceKit: You are out of Maintenance Kit — processing factories will run at only 25% efficiency once production starts.
alerts.noBuildingsYet: You have no buildings yet. Visit Economy to construct your first factory.

economy.title: Industry & Production
economy.subtitle: Manage your factories and construct new buildings. Production runs automatically every day at 00:00 UTC — check back after each day to see your stockpiles grow.

research.title: Technology Tree
research.subtitle: Queue up technologies across 4 branches. Research Points accumulate automatically every day at 00:00 UTC, and flow into whichever tech sits at the top of your queue.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.subtitle: Account-level settings that apply across the whole game.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language for menus, labels, and messages. Currently covers navigation, Dashboard, Economy, Research, Military, Politics, World Bank, Market, Profile, Guide, and Chat.
settings.persistNote: Your choice is saved automatically and stays the same across sessions and page refreshes until you change it again.
settings.postNewsDesc: Shown as a scrolling ticker at the top of every player's Dashboard.

military.title: Armed Forces
military.subtitle: Recruit units and manage active wars. Combat runs as a real-time 60-second battle once troops arrive at their target — open a war below to dispatch an attack.
military.noHospitalWarning: You have injured troops but no hospital built — they will never recover. Build an Emergency Tent in Economy to start healing them.

politics.title: Government & Diplomacy
politics.subtitle: Reform your government's ideology or manage your alliance. Founding an alliance requires Daily GDP of at least $500,000 and costs $1,000,000 upfront. Ideology cooldown is shown for reference but not strictly enforced yet.

bank.title: Credit & Loans
bank.subtitle: Borrow against your credit grade. Your borrowing cap and credit score are based on your real Daily GDP, which grows as your factories produce goods. Loan repayments (principal + interest) are deducted automatically from your cash every day — you can also make extra manual payments any time to pay down debt faster.

market.title: P2P Trading
market.subtitle: List resources for sale or buy from other nations. Sellers set their own price freely. Trades between nations in the same alliance — or allied by an active FTA treaty — get a reduced 5% customs duty split between both alliance treasuries; everyone else pays the standard 15% to the World Bank.
market.noOtherListings: No active listings from other nations yet.

profile.title: Account & Nation Settings
profile.subtitle: Manage your account details and nation identity.
profile.signOutDesc: Sign out of your DexNation account on this device.

guide.title: How to Play
guide.subtitle: A quick reference for keeping your nation stable, plus a breakdown of what each page in the game does.
